selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic were unchanged before and after implementation and reboot.
Ubuntu-supported AIDE 0.18.6-2ubuntu0.1 is installed and operational.
The final root-owned mode-0600 database contains 1,952 entries; the effective configuration applies metadata, ACL, xattr, and SHA-512 checks to `/etc`.
A controlled test produced AIDE status 5 and explicitly reported `/etc/.aide-change-test` as an added entry.
The daily persistent timer is enabled, and its service successfully reports scan results to the journal.

Pre-restart boot ID was 01c87a03-dbeb-4f85-a94d-30e88b180160; the safe reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 6ac34573-1275-4153-b0bb-ee9a565d125f; AIDE, its 1,952-entry database, and the enabled active timer recovered with a clean scan.
